svg.title: Two Panels: Yellow with Large Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Observed tall large blue panel at right with shorter yellow panel at lower left. Upper-left open corner stays transparent. Panel proportions approximate; depth omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moca.org/artworks/two-panels-yellow-with-large-blue; object 85.58A-B; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
